given: the M3 synthetic agency: three crew members, two supervisors and an administrator
one ambulance with two identical kits in one compartment, daily overlapping inspection windows
when: a deficiency is assigned, worked, waits on an external dependency, has an extension requested and decided, is repaired and verified
a compartment-wide deficiency's last two items pass concurrently
the closing verification check is invalidated, verification is added after closure, and an administrator closes and reopens
a supervisor suspends checks and each deficiency closes by a different path
a Critical Failed check and an overdue item are recorded, and the vehicle goes out of service
then: a routine Pass never verifies and the last qualifying check closes exactly once
notifications reach the documented recipients and email goes only through the stub
suspended obligations are never Satisfied and every suspension ends with its deficiency
no event changes operational status and out-of-service time is Exempt
the dashboard shows each RPT-7 state apart
T1/T2/T3 obligations, checklist, dashboard and deficiency states equal shuffled replay after later events
notes: issue 18 (https://github.com/JustApu/CheckYourAmbulance/issues/18) M4 exit integration. Exercises AC-14/16/17/18/19/20/26/27/28 without changing their symbolic catalog status. Real audited commands and database guards; only the clock and the email sender are injected.
